dimensions.assessment: Affects electric utilities, transmission organizations, state regulatory authorities, and electricity ratepayers nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: Upon the request of an electric utility, the Secretary may provide technical assistance... Upon the request of a transmission organization

dimensions.assessment: Provides informational resources, technical support, and NEPA exemptions for advanced transmission projects, but does not mandate utility compliance.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this subsection provides authority for the Secretary or the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to require an electric utility to use any advanced transmission technology.

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for establishing a DOE clearinghouse and providing financial assistance or grants for technology deployment, though specific spending amounts are not detailed.
dimensions.evidence: The term `covered action' means the provision of funding by the Secretary, including a loan or a grant, for the deployment of advanced transmission technology

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Energy Policy Act of 2005, the Energy Policy and Conservation Act, and creates specific NEPA exemptions for funding actions related to advanced transmission technology.
dimensions.evidence: A covered action may not be considered a major Federal action under section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent clearinghouse, technical assistance, and wildfire mitigation frameworks for the bulk-power system.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this subsection, the Secretary shall establish and maintain a publicly available clearinghouse

missing_information: Specific authorized funding levels or dollar amounts for the clearinghouse and grants are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Department of Energy to establish an advanced transmission technology clearinghouse, provide technical assistance, exempt certain technology funding actions from NEPA review, and establish wildfire mitigation best practices.
